data.explanation: This is a second payment reminder from a furniture store for an unpaid balance of €695.00 (remaining payment plus a reminder fee). The letter sets a payment deadline of 11 December 2026 and warns that if payment does not arrive by then, the debt will be passed to a debt collection agency (Inkassounternehmen), whose additional costs you would also have to pay. Check if you already paid the original invoice; if so, keep proof of payment. Otherwise, transfer the amount to the IBAN shown before the stated date to avoid extra collection costs. If you dispute the amount, contact the company directly.
